thesis: Buyer-side user provisioning and deprovisioning for SaaS apps that lack SCIM or lock it behind enterprise tiers, sold to mid-market IT teams rather than to app developers.

vendors.name: WorkOS
vendors.offering: Enterprise SSO and Directory Sync (SCIM) APIs for B2B SaaS developers
vendors.pricing: Per connection: $125/mo for connections 1-15, falling to $65 at 51-100; SSO and SCIM billed as separate connections

vendors.name: Stytch
vendors.offering: B2B auth platform with SSO and SCIM connections from one shared pool
vendors.pricing: Pay-as-you-go: 5 SSO/SCIM connections free (shared pool), then $125 per connection/month; annual contract also sold via AWS Marketplace (see wtp_sources)

vendors.name: SSOJet
vendors.offering: Low-cost enterprise SSO and SCIM layer for SaaS apps
vendors.pricing: Business: $79 per connection/month billed monthly or $59 billed annually (2-4 connections; SSO and SCIM each count as one); volume discounts above; older listings show a $99/mo base structure

vendors.name: Ory Polis (formerly BoxyHQ SAML Jackson)
vendors.offering: Open-source enterprise SSO and SCIM 2.0 directory sync, self-host or managed
vendors.pricing: Open source self-hosted; managed/enterprise usage-based, price not public

vendors.name: Auth0 (Okta)
vendors.offering: CIAM platform with B2B enterprise connections and inbound SCIM
vendors.pricing: Free B2B tier includes 1 SSO connection plus SCIM (Feb 2026); B2B Essentials from $150/mo at 500 MAU; extra connections $100/mo

vendors.name: Clerk
vendors.offering: Developer auth platform bundling SCIM with enterprise connections
vendors.pricing: Pro $25/mo with one enterprise connection; SCIM bundled at no extra charge (vendor-authored source)

vendors.name: Stitchflow
vendors.offering: Provisions apps lacking SCIM via browser automation tied to Okta/Entra
vendors.pricing: Vendor claims under $5K per app per year; list price not public

vendors.name: Okta Lifecycle Management
vendors.offering: IdP-side automated provisioning/deprovisioning to SCIM-enabled apps
vendors.pricing: Included in Core Essentials ($14/user/month), Essentials ($17/user/month) and higher Workforce suites; add-on on Starter ($6/user/month), add-on price not public; billed annually, $1,500 annual minimum

paid_market_gaps.gap: App buyers: 42-43% of 721 SaaS apps lock SCIM behind enterprise tiers; 57% offer no SCIM at all
Per-connection pricing bills SSO and SCIM separately, ~$250/mo per enterprise customer, painful for low-ACV SaaS
Okta's entry Starter suite ($6/user/month) lacks Lifecycle Management; IdP-side SCIM provisioning needs an add-on or an upgrade to Core Essentials ($14/user/month) or above
Self-hosted/open-source auth stacks (SuperTokens, FusionAuth, better-auth) still lack native SCIM support

market_research.wtp_evidence: SaaS developers pay published per-connection prices: Stytch $125/mo after 5 free, or a $25,000/yr contract on AWS Marketplace; WorkOS and SSOJet per-connection prices are in the vendor rows. IT buyers pay enterprise-tier upgrades or Okta Workforce suites that include Lifecycle Management (Core Essentials $14 or Essentials $17 per user/month, billed annually, $1,500 minimum; on the $6 Starter suite it is an add-on), but resent the SSO/SCIM tax.
market_research.bundling_note: Auth platforms now give SCIM away (Auth0 free B2B tier with SCIM, Clerk bundles it on Pro), compressing standalone SCIM-as-a-service pricing toward zero.
market_research.summary: Developer-side SCIM is crowded and being bundled free by Auth0/Clerk; little room. A narrower opening: buyer-side provisioning for apps without SCIM or with enterprise-locked SCIM (Stitchflow's niche), sold to mid-market IT teams.

threat.reason: Prompt deprovisioning removes orphaned accounts attackers reuse; no candidate covers valid-account abuse.

flagged_claims.claim: WorkOS pricing: 'Per connection: $125/mo for connections 1-15, falling to $65 at 51-100; SSO and SCIM billed as separate connections' (source: workos.com/pricing)
flagged_claims.issue: The page lists '$125 / ea' (1-15) down to '$65 / ea' (51-100) under both Single Sign-On and Directory Sync. It never states a monthly billing period for connections; '/mo' appears only for other items such as Audit Logs and Radar. The FAQ says 'Each enterprise customer you support with SSO or Directory Sync is counted as one connection', which does not clearly say SSO and SCIM are billed as separate connections and can be read as the opposite. Separate price tables imply separate billing, but the page never states it.

flagged_claims.claim: WTP: IT buyers '... resent the SSO/SCIM tax.'
flagged_claims.issue: The cited wtp_sources (Stytch pricing, Stytch AWS Marketplace listing, Okta pricing) support the prices: Stytch 5 free connections then $125 per connection; a $25,000/12-month Stytch Platform contract; Okta Core Essentials $14 and Essentials $17, billed annually with a $1,500 minimum; Lifecycle Management an add-on on Starter. None of them shows buyer resentment of an 'SSO/SCIM tax'. That part is unsupported by the WTP sources.
